cityjsonSamples.label: Hamburg city center - official LoD2 buildings
cityjsonSamples.description: Local editable fallback from the Elbe waterfront through Rathaus to Jungfernstieg. The default citywide display streams official Hamburg LoD1, LoD2, and LoD3 3D Tiles and materializes any picked detailed remote building into CityJSON on demand.

cityjsonSamples.label: Hamburg city center - editable CityJSON roads
cityjsonSamples.description: Compact precomputed center sample retained for manual loading. The default app now viewport-streams the complete static gzip CityJSONSeq catalog.

cityjsonSamples.label: Hamburg osm2streets roads - real fixture
cityjsonSamples.description: Real native osm2streets lane-polygons output from the Hamburg short-intersection OSM fixture, converted to CityJSON Transportation Road surfaces.

streamingSources.label: Hamburg citywide official LoD1 overview
streamingSources.editing: Read-only overview source; zoom to LoD2 or LoD3 to materialize a building for editing.

streamingSources.label: Hamburg citywide official LoD2 buildings
streamingSources.editing: Semantic roof/wall colours are applied in the streamed tile; the picked batch feature is converted into local EPSG:25832 CityJSON and its remote duplicate is hidden.

streamingSources.label: Complete Hamburg osm2streets CityJSON roads
streamingSources.format: 930 static 1 km CityJSONSeq gzip tiles; 344,265 roads and 206,426 linked intersections
streamingSources.editing: Visible tiles are editable in memory; use Save local or Export CityJSON because GitHub Pages is read-only.

planningLayers.label: Hamburg citywide FNP planning areas
planningLayers.notes: Loaded once as interactive vectors across Hamburg and cached for the browser session.

planningLayers.label: Hamburg XPlan building-use areas
planningLayers.notes: Fetched live for the settled viewport and refreshed after pan/zoom; no backend needed while CORS remains open.

planningLayers.label: Hamburg FNP land-use fallback
planningLayers.notes: Available as a bbox-scoped fallback; the default citywide overview uses the OGC API collection above.
